interpretation.contentCheckLimit: The sanitized SQL checks marker ContentJson execution identity and commit-ID presence, but does not emit raw commit IDs or prove the commit hash/content equality directly; that part remains the source store contract.
interpretation.dispatch: Zero surviving workflow-dispatch rows was observed. Dispatch retention/deletion means this is not proof of zero historical dispatches.
interpretation.durableCheckpointMarkers: The matched immutable marker rows are direct retained evidence of durable checkpoint-marker creation for these execution identities; marker schema/revision and sanitized execution/commit-presence checks passed for all retained marker rows.
interpretation.operations: The existing probe remains the source for command/statement/transaction/operation attribution. Marker rows must not be relabeled as operation spans; these results do not prove physical network round trips or affected-row counts.
interpretation.outbox: The current retained outbox rows were all Delivered for the Immediate cases; no current outbox rows remained for Coalesced. These are current-state observations, not historical creation totals.
interpretation.scheduler: Zero residual scheduler rows was observed. Consumed/deleted scheduler history cannot be reconstructed posthoc.

A requirement for historical dispatch totals or globally unique consumed-work totals would require append-only retained identities or a fresh approved capture with raw ID joins.
A claim about physical round trips or exact statement ownership would require the already-scoped protocol/EF correlation evidence, not this row audit.
